name: IRC
author: OscarGalindo
css: :root { --font-sans: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Courier New', monospace, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji' !important; --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace !important; } * { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Fira Code', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Courier New', monospace, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji' !important; } [data-workspace-area='conversation'] { background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,.02) 0px, rgba(255,255,255,.02) 1px, transparent 1px, transparent 3px), #0f0f0f !important; } [data-message-role='user'] { background: #101c30 !important; border-radius: 0 !important; margin-top: 22px !important; margin-bottom: 12px !important; margin-left: 5px !important; margin-right: 5px !important; } [data-user-message-bubble] { background: transparent !important; border: none !important; border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: none !important; margin: 0 !important; text-align: left !important; padding: 8px 12px !important; color: #7fb0ff !important; font-size: 13px !important; text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(91,157,255,.2); } [data-message-role='user'] div.w-full.justify-end.pe-1.tabular-nums { opacity: 1 !important; transition: none !important; justify-content: flex-start !important; width: 100% !important; max-width: none !important; margin: 0 !important; padding-left: 12px !important; padding-right: 0 !important; } [data-message-role='user'] div.w-full.justify-end.pe-1.tabular-nums .ms-auto, [data-message-role='user'] div.w-full.justify-end.pe-1.tabular-nums .ml-auto { margin-left: 0 !important; } [data-timeline-row-kind] span.whitespace-nowrap.rounded-md.tabular-nums { opacity: 1 !important; position: static !important; pointer-events: auto !important; transition: none !important; } .chat-markdown { font-size: 14px; } .chat-markdown a { color: #39c5d3; text-decoration: underline; } .chat-markdown a:hover { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(57,197,211,.5); } .chat-markdown-codeblock { border: 1px solid #262626 !important; border-radius: 0 !important; } [data-timeline-row-kind] { border-radius: 0 !important; } [data-timeline-row-kind='work'] { color: #3fbf7f; font-size: 12px; } [data-chat-header] h2 { font-weight: 700 !important; font-size: 15px; } [data-slot='composer-host'] { background: #0d0d0d !important; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a !important; border-radius: 0 !important; box-shadow: none !important; } [data-slot='composer-host']:focus-within { border-color: rgba(0,194,209,.55) !important; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,194,209,.15) !important; } .composer-tiptap { font-size: 13px; } [data-chat-header] { border-bottom: 1px solid #262626 !important; } [data-thread-item] span.text-start { font-weight: 700 !important; font-size: 13px !important; } [data-thread-item]:has([aria-current]) div[role='button'] { box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 #35597f !important; } [data-slot='sidebar'], [data-slot='sidebar'] *, [data-slot='sidebar-inner'], [data-slot='sidebar-inner'] * { border-radius: 0 !important; } [data-thread-item], [data-slot='button'], [data-slot='input'], [data-slot='select-trigger'], [data-slot='dialog-popup'], [data-slot='popover-popup'], [data-slot='menu-popup'] { border-radius: 0 !important; } [data-slot='button'] { box-shadow: none !important; } [data-slot='scroll-area-thumb'] { border-radius: 0 !important; } ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #2a2a2a; border: 2px solid #0b0b0b; } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #3a3a3a; } .messages-timeline-scroll { line-height: 1.5; }
